column5: GROUP: **proof-admission** | 1. `adm/integer_rules.rs:686-701`: cast bound conversion accepts when the root and target are the embedded chain values on matching sides and the other side is structurally equal; the other side is not required to be a literal. Whether `ProofRule::IntegerCastBound` can supply an arbitrary term was not traced. (checked: code matches.)

GROUP: **proof-admission** | 2. `adm/integer_affine.rs:2945-2964`: recognisers 7 and 8 return a form from the shape of `witness.target` with no `context.validate` call, so a Value-typed root not in `context` is not rejected there. Whether the proof rule validates witness terms was not traced. (checked: `adm/proof.rs:482` passes the witness straight in; I did not trace validation of node conclusions.)
GROUP: **proof-admission** | 3. `adm/integer_affine.rs:2953-2964`: the shift count is ignored (`count: _`); the bound mapper later demands count evidence (`:1372`).

GROUP: **proof-admission** | 4. `adm/integer_affine.rs:2491-2535`: `bounded_bitwise_sibling` finds mask bounds by searching uncited prior axioms and does not validate them; "depends on whether semantic_axioms are validated earlier by the caller". (checked: both entry paths validate every semantic axiom first, `adm/proof.rs:189-193`, `bd:15303-15307`. The axioms are still found by search, not by cited index.)

GROUP: **proof-admission** | 5. `adm/mathematical_core.rs:3664-3666`: assumption closure skips a constant index missing from the signature. Not traced into callers; the verifier separately rejects unknown declarations (`:1148`).

GROUP: **proof-admission** | 6. `adm/mathematical_typing.rs:1375-1378`: conversion returns `true` for any two terms at a Strict-sorted shared type and never checks that they inhabit it. The design is "stated" (header `:7-8`); the one external caller `adm/mathematical_core.rs:1311` is "open". Wrong input a reader named: a caller supplying wrongly typed terms with a strict shared type.

GROUP: **proof** | 7. `prf/checker.rs:342-344`, `:472`: an assignment judged "overwritten before consumption" skips all checks, including named constraints; the later assignment is matched by `display_name` equality. Wrong program a reader named: a different place that displays identically, such as a shadowed local with the same spelling. Open for shadowing. (checked: code matches.)

GROUP: **proof** | 8. `prf/checker.rs:374-399`, `:547-577`, `:623-642`, `:689-715`, `:762-808`: when the certificate builder returns `Uncovered`, the older interval path accepts without the kernel. "Traced" for control flow, "open" for soundness of the `validation::*` helpers.
